duration.$description: Transition durations, named by value in ms. Components use the roles in semantic/motion.json, not these.

standard.$description: The default, for movement and change on screen: form field focus, select options and the toggle track (form.scss), the circle button (button.scss), the button focus bar (_utilities.scss), accordion icons (accordion.scss), menu and tab indicators (menu.scss, tabs.scss), expanding stat content (stat.scss), blockquote bars (blockquote.scss) and banner media (banner.scss).

enter.$description: Something arriving or expanding: it starts quickly and settles gently. Tab backgrounds (tabs.scss).

overshoot.$description: A small overshoot for playful emphasis: the toggle switch knob (form.scss) and the stat reveal (stat.scss).
